label: Aiko Tanaka, product designer
html:
<style>
  #pf-bento {
    --background: oklch(0.955 0.004 260);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.01 260);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0.004 260);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.5 0.01 260);
    --border: oklch(0.91 0.005 260);
    --input: var(--border);
    --primary: oklch(0.66 0.19 42);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.004 260);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.03 60);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    container: pf-bento / inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
  }
  .dark #pf-bento {
    --background: oklch(0.13 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.96 0 0);
    --card: oklch(0.19 0.004 260);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.004 260);
    --secondary: oklch(0.24 0.004 260);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.7 0.01 260);
    --border: oklch(0.27 0.006 260);
    --primary: oklch(0.72 0.17 45);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.02 45);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.03 60);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(11rem, auto);
    grid-template-areas:
      'intro intro photo avail'
      'intro intro photo place'
      'work work stat tools'
      'work work quote links'
      'write write now now';
    gap: 0.875rem;
    max-width: 80rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-tile {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 1rem);
    background: var(--card);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-intro {
    grid-area: intro;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3cqi, 2.5rem);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo {
    grid-area: photo;
    padding: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-avail {
    grid-area: avail;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-place {
    grid-area: place;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    --shape-ink: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 11%, transparent);
    --shape-pattern: 24px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--card) 85%, oklch(0.8 0.08 200));
    position: relative;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-work {
    grid-area: work;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-stat {
    grid-area: stat;
    justify-content: space-between;
    border-color: transparent;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-tools {
    grid-area: tools;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-quote {
    grid-area: quote;
    justify-content: space-between;
    border-color: transparent;
    background: var(--foreground);
    color: var(--background);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-links {
    grid-area: links;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: transparent;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-muted {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-label {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-stat .pf-label,
  #pf-bento .pf-quote .pf-label {
    color: inherit;
    opacity: 0.75;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 3.2cqi, 3.75rem);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-title .text-rotate {
    display: block;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 16rem;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-big {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 2rem + 3cqi, 4.5rem);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 0.9;
    letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-pin {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: 1.25rem;
    inset-inline-end: 1.25rem;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.25rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--card);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-quote blockquote {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.35;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-links ul {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-work .mk-portfolio-grid {
    flex: 1;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(9.5rem, 1fr);
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-availability {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    background: none;
  }
  /* the portrait opens About, the work opens the case viewer: buttons that look like what they hold */
  #pf-bento .pf-photo button,
  #pf-bento button.mk-portfolio-grid-link {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: inherit;
    cursor: zoom-in;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo button {
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo-tag {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto 0.875rem 0.875rem auto;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(0.15 0 0 / 0.6);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo-tag svg {
    width: 0.9rem;
    height: 0.9rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo button:hover .pf-photo-tag {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-photo button, button.mk-portfolio-grid-link):focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: -3px;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo img {
    transition: scale 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-photo button:hover img {
    scale: 1.04;
  }
  /* availability: how full the next quarter is */
  #pf-bento .pf-slots {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-block-start: auto;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-slots p {
    margin: 0;
  }
  /* the clock in Tokyo */
  #pf-bento .pf-clock {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.25rem + 2cqi, 2.75rem);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-clock-note {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  /* the quote tile: three quotes in one cell, radios pick one (:has()) */
  #pf-bento .pf-quotes {
    display: grid;
    margin-block-start: auto;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-quotes figure {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    translate: 0 0.5rem;
    transition:
      opacity 0.35s,
      translate 0.35s,
      visibility 0.35s;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-quote:has([value='0']:checked) .pf-quotes figure:nth-child(1),
  #pf-bento .pf-quote:has([value='1']:checked) .pf-quotes figure:nth-child(2),
  #pf-bento .pf-quote:has([value='2']:checked) .pf-quotes figure:nth-child(3) {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    translate: 0 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-quotes figcaption {
    margin-block-start: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    opacity: 0.75;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dots input {
    appearance: none;
    width: 0.55rem;
    height: 0.55rem;
    margin: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: 0.35;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      width 0.3s,
      opacity 0.3s;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dots input:checked {
    width: 1.5rem;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dots input:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }
  /* the links: labelled, and the address to copy */
  #pf-bento .pf-links .btn {
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-mail {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    user-select: all;
  }
  /* writing and now */
  #pf-bento .pf-write {
    grid-area: write;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-write .accordion-trigger span {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.15rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-write .accordion-trigger small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-write .accordion-content p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-now {
    grid-area: now;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--card) 88%, var(--primary));
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-now dl {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 0.9rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-now dt {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-now dt svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-now dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  /* the dialogs: the case viewer (Media Gallery's), About and Hire me */
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track p {
    max-width: 42rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer::backdrop {
    background: oklch(0.08 0.01 260 / 0.94);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer strong {
    color: #fff;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer-steps {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer-step {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.75rem;
    height: 2.75rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15);
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer-step:hover {
    background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.28);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-viewer-step:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #fff;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dialog {
    width: min(94vw, 34rem);
    max-height: min(92dvh, 52rem);
    margin: auto;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 1rem);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2xl);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dialog::backdrop {
    background: oklch(0.15 0 0 / 0.5);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dialog-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.75rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dialog h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-dialog .pf-dialog-x {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    background: var(--card);
    inset: 0.75rem 0.75rem auto auto;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about {
    width: min(94vw, 56rem);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 3fr);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about-grid > img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 18rem;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about ol {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 6.5rem 1fr;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-about li span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-row {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-pair {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-hire:not([data-sent]) .pf-hire-done,
  #pf-bento .pf-hire[data-sent] form {
    display: none;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-hire-done {
    justify-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-hire-done > svg {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-hire-done p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  @container pf-bento (max-width: 40rem) {
    #pf-bento .pf-about-grid {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
    #pf-bento .pf-about-grid > img {
      min-height: 0;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    }
    #pf-bento .pf-pair {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #pf-bento :is(.pf-quotes figure, .pf-dots input, .pf-photo img, .pf-photo-tag) {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  @container pf-bento (max-width: 62rem) {
    #pf-bento .pf-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      grid-template-areas:
        'intro intro'
        'photo avail'
        'photo place'
        'work work'
        'stat tools'
        'quote links'
        'write now';
    }
  }
  @container pf-bento (max-width: 34rem) {
    #pf-bento .pf-grid {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      grid-template-areas: 'intro' 'photo' 'avail' 'place' 'work' 'stat' 'tools' 'quote' 'links' 'write' 'now';
    }
  }
  /* light or dark: the Swap writes the page's dark class - every look has a light and a dark palette */
  #pf-bento .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the Site Header: one more tile - the portrait as a squircle, the sections, About, Hire me and the mode */
  #pf-bento .mk-header {
    max-width: 80rem;
    margin: 0 auto 0.875rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 1rem);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 0.75rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-header-brand {
    gap: 0.75rem;
    color: inherit;
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-header-brand img {
    width: 2.75rem;
    height: 2.75rem;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.mk-header-name, .mk-footer-brand-name) {
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-header-nav {
    display: flex;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  #pf-bento .nav-menu-link {
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .nav-menu-link[aria-current] {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #pf-bento .mk-header-actions .btn {
    border-radius: 999px;
  }
  /* a case and a note: the same tiles, arranged for reading */
  #pf-bento .pf-case {
    grid-template-areas:
      'head head head metric'
      'cover cover cover cover'
      'facts brief brief shot'
      'result work work shot'
      'prev prev next next';
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-head {
    grid-area: head;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3cqi, 2.5rem);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-lede {
    max-width: 46rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-metric {
    grid-area: metric;
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-case-cover, .pf-case-shot) {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-cover {
    grid-area: cover;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-shot {
    grid-area: shot;
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-case-cover, .pf-case-shot) img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-cover img {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-facts {
    grid-area: facts;
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-facts dt {
    margin-block-start: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-facts dt:first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-facts dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-brief {
    grid-area: brief;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-work {
    grid-area: work;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-result {
    grid-area: result;
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: transparent;
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-case-brief, .pf-case-work, .pf-case-result) p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step {
    justify-content: space-between;
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step + .pf-case-step {
    grid-area: next;
    align-items: flex-end;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step:first-of-type {
    grid-area: prev;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step .pf-label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-case-step strong {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1rem + 1cqi, 1.75rem);
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-case-step, .pf-back) svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-back {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    align-self: flex-start;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-back:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-note {
    grid-template-areas: 'note note note list';
  }
  #pf-bento :is(.pf-case, .pf-note) {
    grid-auto-rows: auto;
  }
  #pf-bento .nav-menu-link {
    line-height: 1.25rem;
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-note-pager {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 40rem;
    padding-block-start: 1.25rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #pf-bento .pf-note-pager a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
